hypothesis: An edit fragment is not necessarily a standalone program. Resolve otherwise-unparseable fragments through their unique exact-byte location in the complete original/modified AST, rather than changing semantic decisions or encoder policy.
change: Keep the same encoder registry, all17 trials and all12 fixed first alerts. Only contextual fragment parsing changes. Missing, ambiguous or invalid complete-source embeddings remain unknown.

decision: Retain implementation and source-only preparation. Do not count an unevaluated result or promote it after the ten-hour deadline.
